messages.subject: Error in surveyReport
parts:
Hello, I have this problem, I see that someone has asked it before, but I can't understand what it says, please tell me how to solve this：
Error in surveyReport(recordTable = rec.db1, CTtable = Station, camOp = camop_no_problem,  :
  Not all values of stationCol in recordTable are matched by values of stationCol in CTtable

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in surveyReport
parts:
Hi,
this error means that there are stations in your record table that are not found in your camera trap table.

Try with the GitHub version, it gives a better error message than the CRAN version. See this commit. To install:

install.packages("R.rsp")
remotes::install_github("jniedballa/camtrapR", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Best regards,
Jürgen
